units.source_text: 古歌：“有山名恋爱，其深不可测。

en.t: An old poem says: There is a mountain called Love, and its depths cannot be measured.

units.source_text: 从来入山者，路迷不得出。”

en.t: Those who have entered that mountain have always lost their way and been unable to come out.
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu Rokujō.
